headline: DevSecOps Engineer
summary: Over the past 3 years, I’ve specialized in DevSecOps engineering, building robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, ArgoCD) and leading infrastructure migrations to containerized and virtualized platforms (Kubernetes, Proxmox). Passionate about automation, security, and delivering scalable solutions that empower development teams. Versatile software operator with 5 years of experience in system administration across Windows and Linux environments and development (TypeScript, C#, Python, Elixir).

bullets: Managed the migration of services from a bare metal to a virtualized and containerized infrastructure, and set up security systems (IAM system with Active Directory, WiFi WPA2 & 3 Enterprise, VLANs, Backups, DRP, NIS2).

Migrated (from Jenkins) and started from scratch GitLab CI/CD pipeline systems with a self-hosted runner for multi-containers monorepo projects to help developers have important information about their test suites (unit, integration, e2e) as well as automatic deployment.
Implemented a rest api scraper in Typescript/Node.js to collect and monitor information from several electronic equipment suppliers and developed a web interface on top of it in Elixir/Phoenix.

experience.title: System Administrator
bullets: Maintained and managed the company's internal IT equipment, with a focus on cybersecurity (Active Directory DS, CS, DNS, Radius, VLANs, Windows Server, ESET Protect, Backups Management, Exchange, DKIM, DMARC, PKI).

Developed a software (C#, .NET 6, PowerShell) to monitor the status of the company's servers backups by interfacing a native PowerShell module provided by Windows Server and creating a weekly html email table with the help of razor template builder.
Developed MRI image processing pipelines with python and its libraries.
Developed an R library to facilitate the graphical representation of somatotopy data.
